title: Looking at photographs: the WPA band and uncle Joshua Haynes
summary: Photos are brought out; the WPA band is spotted, and Richard McLean identifies his uncle Joshua Haynes, photographed in Chicago with a singing club.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel
